Atal Bihari Vajpayee Medical University, Uttar Pradesh

Uttar Pradesh Common Allied Healthcare Entrance Test (CAHET) 2026

ABVMU CAHET 2026 Exam : Short Details of Notification

Important Dates

  • Application Begin :02/05/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online :14/06/2026
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date :14/06/2026
  • Correction Date :30/05/2026 to 05/06/2026
  • UG Merit List : As per Schedule
  • PG Exam Date :21/06/2026
  • Admit Card Available :15/06/2026

Application Fee

  • For UG Courses :
  • General / OBC / EWS: 750/-
  • SC / ST / PH : 500/-
  • For PG Courses :
  • General / OBC / EWS: 3000/-
  • SC / ST / PH : 2000/-
  • Pay the Exam Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking Only.

UP Common Allied Healthcare Entrance Test CAHET Notification 2026 : Age Limit as on 31/12/2026

  • Minimum Age : 17 Years.
  • Maximum Age : NA
  • Age Relaxation Extra as per ABVMU, Lucknow UP Common Allied Healthcare Entrance Test (CAHET) Admissions Rules.

Uttar Pradesh Common Allied Healthcare Entrance Test (CAHET) Admissions 2026:  Admissions Details

Course

UP CAHET Entrance Test Course Details

Under Graduate
  1. Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science (B.MLS)
  2. Bachelor of Optometry (B.OPTOM)
  3. Bachelor of Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology (B.AOTT)
  4. Bachelor of Medical Radiology & Imaging Technology (B.MRIT)
  5. Bachelor in Audiology and Speech Language Pathology (B.ASLP)
  6. Bachelor of Physiotherapy (B.PT)
  7. Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (B.OT)
  8. Bachelor of Radiation Therapy Technology (B.RTT)

Post Graduate (Master)
  1. Master of Medical Laboratory Science
  2. Master of Optometry
  3. Master of Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology
  4. Master of Medical Radiology & Imaging Technology
  5. Master of Physiotherapy
  6. Master of Occupational Therapy
  7. M.Sc. Audiology

ABVMU CAHET PG 2026 Admissions : Exam District Details

  • Agra, Bareilly, Ghaziabad, Gorakhpur, Kanpur, Lucknow & Varanasi



How to Fill Common Allied Healthcare  ABVMU CAHET 2026 Online Form

  • Cast Certificate Instruction :  OBC and EWS certificate should be issued after 01/04/2026.
  • Photo Instruction : The photograph should be full face, from front, with white background and without spectacles along with the name of the candidate and date of photograph should be written on the photograph.
  • Live Photo : CAHET 2026 Live Photo Also Required
  • Atal Bihari Vajpayee Medical University, Uttar Pradesh Common Allied Healthcare Entrance Test (CAHET) Notification Released. Candidate Can Apply From 02/05/2026  to 14/06/2026.
  • Candidate Read the Notification Before Apply the Admission Application Form in Atal Bihari Vajpayee Medical University, ABVMU Lucknow Kindly Check and Collect the All Document – Eligibility, ID Proof, Address Details, Basic Details.
  • Kindly Ready Scan Document Related to Recruitment Form – Photo, Sign, ID Proof, Etc.
  • Before Submit the Application Form Must Check the Preview and All Column Carefully.
  • If Candidate Required to Paying the Application Fee Must Submit. If You have Not the Required Application Fees Your Form is Not Completed.
  • Take A Print Out of Final Submitted Form.
  • For the latest updates on Sarkari Result, admit card, answer key, and result, always visit SarkariResult.com, the official website for Sarkari Result in India (Since 2012).

Interested Candidate Can Read the Full ABVMU UP CAHET Admission 2026 Notification Before Apply Online.
